environment.description: Same Actix-web binary deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule group 'product-search-input-validation' with a RegexPatternSet match on the 'category' query string parameter that blocks requests where category contains characters outside [a-zA-Z0-9_-] using a BLOCK action with priority 1, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in COUNT mode (monitoring phase before enforcement). The custom rule (2) applies a byte-match condition specifically on the SingleQueryArgument 'category' with a RegexPatternSet that rejects any value not matching ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,50}$. CloudWatch metrics confirm this rule has blocked 0 legitimate requests in 30 days of production traffic.

config.waf_rule_2: Custom rule group 'product-search-input-validation': RegexPatternSet on SingleQueryArgument 'category', pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,50}$, action BLOCK, priority 1
config.waf_rule_3: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet - ALL rules in COUNT mode (monitoring only)
config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
config.runtime: ECS Fargate task with read-only root filesystem
config.database: SQLite on EFS mount with read-only task mount
